name: Lobsterman Dennis

intro.text: Pots down at dawn, pots up at dusk. The sea decides, and the quota decides after that. Fancy a bet on the weather?

win: A fair haul. I'll tell the factory you've been unusually kind.
after: The crawfish fishery on Tristan is certified sustainable: strict quotas, minimum sizes and a closed season. It supports the whole island, and a lot of tea.
